injuries.name: Kerby Joseph
injuries.note: Lions head coach Dan Campbell stated Kerby (knee) "is in a good headspace" and expects the 25-year-old to play at some point this season, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Ben Bartch
injuries.note: The Lions placed Bartch (foot) on injured reserve Friday.

injuries.name: Devin White

injuries.name: Tom Kennedy

injuries.name: Jordon Riley
injuries.note: The Packers activated Riley (Achilles) from the active/PUP list Saturday.

injuries.name: Aaron Banks
injuries.note: Banks (knee/toe) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Bo Melton
injuries.note: Melton (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Zaire Franklin
injuries.note: Franklin (shin) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Luke Musgrave
injuries.note: Packers head coach Matt Lafleur said Thursday it's "tough to say" whether Musgrave (neck) plays this season, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injuries.name: Micah Parsons
injuries.note: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said that Parsons (knee) won't practice in Week 7, Weston Hodkiewicz of the team's official site reports. "He has to clear some hurdles yet before we get to that point," LaFleur said.

injuries.name: Jonathan Ford
injuries.note: The Packers placed Ford (calf) on injured reserve Saturday.
